title: The Garden Chapel Service
seo_title: The Garden Chapel Service on Nov 29, 2026
description: The Garden Chapel Service is a weekly Sunday gathering led by Pastor Al, held in the Garden Chapel, which sits against a hillside and has traditional church pews and floor-to-ceiling windows. It takes place on Sunday, November 29, 2026, from 9:00 AM to 9:45 AM at the Garden Chapel.
